item.title: Disability and Health Services Research and Policy
item.content:encoded:
This special issue addresses the intersection of disability with health services research and policy. The collection seeks to advance understanding of how health systems and policies affect people with disabilities and to promote evidence-based approaches that improve healthcare delivery and outcomes for this population.
